candidates.title: Vallee hints Bob Lazar was an MK Ultra subject
candidates.quote: when he hints that Bob Lazar was actually an MK Ultra patient possibly the subject of government brainwashing which led him to believe he worked on reverse engineering UFOs
documents: Revelations: Alien Contact and Human Deception

link.reason: Both are about Bob Lazar's claim to have reverse-engineered UFOs at S4 in Nevada in the late 1980s. This telling, drawn from Vallee's book Revelations, explains that claim as the product of MK Ultra-style government brainwashing, not real work on alien craft, so the two accounts cannot both be right.
link.difference: Credits Jacques Vallee's book Revelations: Alien Contact and Human Deception with hinting that Lazar was an MK Ultra subject brainwashed into believing he had reverse-engineered UFOs, where the story presents Lazar's own claim that he really did that work.

candidates.title: Vallee suspected a secret real project behind Project Blue Book
candidates.quote: project rule book was the best I could do at the time because I felt they had a real project going on that was secret

link.reason: The nearest story, air-force-project-blue-book-1947, tells of Blue Book itself as the Air Force's UFO investigation. This telling is Vallee's firsthand suspicion that a separate, secret real project sat behind Blue Book. That is a distinct claim about a hidden program, not an account of Blue Book, so it is a different story.

candidates.title: Trinity crash of 1945 at San Antonio, New Mexico
candidates.quote: through that opening of one panel that's missing they see three creatures they were human-like they had two eyes

link.reason: Both tellings describe the same 1945 Trinity crash-retrieval in New Mexico. The story is told at the same grain: one crash event, not a program or a group of crashes.
link.difference: Vallee tells it secondhand, crediting Paola Harris, Remy Baca, Jose Padilla and the book Trinity: The Best-Kept Secret, and places it at San Antonio, NM. He adds that three human-like two-eyed creatures were seen through a missing panel, where the story's host telling speaks only of a larger piece coming from the crash.

candidates.title: Custody of the Trinity craft passed through Manhattan Project, AEC and DOE clearances
candidates.quote: Manhattan Project would have custody of it and then it would go into the atomic energy commission and then it would go into the department of energy which has its own line of clearances

link.reason: The nearest story is the 1945 Trinity crash told as the source of a larger piece. This telling is a separate theory about who held the recovered craft afterwards, passing from the Manhattan Project to the AEC and then the DOE from 1945 to the present. It is about what happened after the crash, not the crash itself.

link.reason: This telling is about one personal incident: Chris Mellon nearly met an aerospace insider from a UFO program, and the contact died before the meeting. None of the stories covers it. The closest is the AATIP program story, but that describes the whole program, not a single missed meeting.

candidates.title: Wilson memo on a private aerospace reverse-engineering program

link.reason: The telling is about the Wilson memo, which describes a 1997 meeting between Admiral Thomas Wilson and Eric Davis about a private reverse-engineering program. The nearest story is the Vallee–Davis six-level paper, which has Davis in common but is a different document, and the Lazar S4 story is a different claim about reverse engineering.
